correctness.rationale: The descending-link criterion is exact for the unfilled 1-complex. The exhaustive classification by first vertices yields all stars and flaps and explicit orders realize them. Each relative mixed face is in a unique flap and the pivot pairs are genuine free elementary collapses in decreasing size. The star quotient is the connected multigraph with 2mn edges and m+n vertices; Euler rank follows. Finite verifier checks seven nontrivial pairs (including boundary m=n=2) but is not substituted for symbolic proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural two-parameter integral homotopy classification and explicit graph reduction. The initial complexes have arbitrarily high dimension while their homotopy lies entirely in degree one. Previously known thin-side information and general Morse machinery do not provide this structural uniform reduction.
